description: Fetch a url from the internet: {url, method, headers, body, timeoutMs} -> the outside answer as it comes, its status and content type kept. It never reaches this machine: a url on loopback, localhost, 0.0.0.0, :: or one of this machine's own interface addresses (or a name that resolves to one) is refused 403, code this-machine, and nothing is sent. The headers go as given: no key is filled in and no list gates them.
